Name: Assignment
Description: A set of information about a person assignment. The assignment includes the person's job, position, grade, department and location.
Date Effectivity: Date effective with multiple changes per day

Name: Assignment Eligible Job
Description: An additional job that a worker is eligible to work for. You can record additional jobs as eligible jobs. This feature can be used in scenarios where a person is required to report time for additional jobs. The feature can also be used where a person is working on more than one job, and the additional jobs need to be stored in the application for tracking purpose.

Name: Assignment Extra Information
Description: The extra information captured about the assignment using the configurable structure of the Assignment extensible flexfield.

Name: Assignment Grade Steps
Description: An increment in an assignment grade that is usually associated with a step rate value.

Name: Assignment Supervisor
Description: The manager for an assignment. Manager details include the manager type and person number of the manager.

Name: Assignment Work Measure
Description: The HR budget values, such as full-time equivalency and headcount for an assignment.

Name: Contract
Description: The contract details that are associated with employment terms or assignments.

Name: Employment Terms
Description: Terms and conditions associated with one or more assignments in a work relationship. Customers not using the 3-Tier employment model, and hence not using terms, will still have to supply terms metadata and merge lines.
Date Effectivity: Date effective with multiple changes per day

Name: External Identifier
Description: A person's identifier in an external application. For example a third-party payroll identifier, or a time device badge identifier.

Name: Person Address
Description: The postal address of a person, which includes country dependent elements. For example, a UK address comprises Address Line 1 - 3, City or Town, County, Post Code, and Country, while a US address comprises Address Line 1 - 3, City, State, ZIP Code, and County.

Name: Person Citizenship
Description: The state or nation to which the person belongs, is a native of, or a naturalized member.

Name: Person Delivery Method
Description: Specify the different methods of communication with the person. For example, this may include phone, email, IM, and so on.

Name: Person Drivers License
Description: The driver's license of a person. It includes the validity dates and the issuing authority of the license.

Name: Person E-Mail
Description: Specify the personal or work email address of a person.

Name: Person Ethnicity
Description: A value that identifies the cultural or racial group to which the person belongs.

Name: Person Image
Description: The photo of a person. Also, indicate if it is the primary photo of the person.

Name: Person Legislative Data
Description: The legislation-specific data of a person. It can include the legislation code, marital status, gender, and other legislation-specific information.

Name: Person Name
Description: The global and local name attributes of a person. The attributes may vary by country. For example, for a US employee the attributes may include first name, middle names, and last name, while for UK employee the attributes may include title, first name, last name and suffix.

Name: Person National Identifier
Description: A unique alpha-numeric number assigned by a legal authority to represent a person. For example, this can be the Social Security Number in the US, and the National Insurance Number in the UK.

Name: Person Passport
Description: The type, number, and issuing authority of a person's passport.

Name: Person Phone
Description: The work and personal phone number details of a person.

Name: Person Religion
Description: The religion name of a person. This information is country specific.

Name: Person User Manual Roles
Description: The roles available for manual assignment to a new hire. Update the user information in the User object.

Name: Person Visa
Description: The validity dates and issuing authority of a person's visa or work permit.

Name: Seniority Date
Description: The dates on which the calculation of a worker's length of service with an entity is based. These entities could be Enterprise, Legal Employer, Country, Department, Grade, Grade Step, Job, Location, Position, Union, Bargaining Unit and Collective Agreement.

Name: Seniority Hour
Description: Defines seniority hour for an assignment.

Name: User Information
Description: The user account of a new hire. Update the user information in the User object.

Name: Work Relationship
Description: The relationship between the legal employer and the worker that includes the type, start date, and name of the legal employer.

Name: Worker
Description: A person who has a work relationship with a legal employer within the enterprise.

Name: Worker Extra Information
Description: The extra information captured about the person using the configurable structure of the Person extensible flexfield.

Name: Working Hour Pattern
Description: The pattern of working hours for an assignment.
